item.tib: 'jigs byed gshed nag gi dgongs gsol las bzhi myur 'grub
item.coloph: 'jigs byed gshin rje nag gi dgongs gsol las bzhi myur 'grub 'di ni/ bsdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa (?)shel bzhin sogs/ nye gnas 'ga' yis bskul phyir/ snyigs dus kyi dka' thub zme ston nyi ri wer zhis/ 'du gnas rin chen 'bar ba'i yang dben mthong grol khrod du sbyar ba'o//
